text.what: From Ladoix south to Maranges, where the hill turns and chardonnay takes the best of it. Corton is its only red grand cru; the reds that matter most sit in Pommard, Volnay and Beaune at premier cru.

kin.as: The southern half of the Côte d'Or.
The hill that holds the district's only red grand cru.
The grape that takes the white flank of the same slope.
Whose vines sit mostly in these communes.
